description: The cassette's bottom plate, on the inside face of the oak bottom: the thumb switches' plate and the main board's floor
notes: Carries the 4 left-thumb and 4 right-thumb switches, with the same 14.0 x 14.0mm cutout geometry, and from the same vendor in the same order as PLATE-TOP - the same switch, the same vendor drawing, the same slot (`plate-thickness`). ONE PLATE, THE LENGTH OF THE MAIN BOARD (ADR 0024): it also carries a MECH-MB-STUD at every mount, pressed in from its underside, and the U-bolt's leg holes. Cut file mechanical/export/plate-bottom.dxf. GROUNDED THROUGH THE MAIN BOARD'S MOUNTS (ADR 0024): each stud's clinch and each spacer's face must be metal to metal with the plate, so ORDER IT UN-ANODISED, or mask a 6 mm spot round each stud hole on both faces before finishing. Meter it to PWR_GND at bring-up: under 1 ohm
